Retrieve AssetAccessPolicyConfig. AssetAccessPolicyConfig - Per-policy configuration entry. Corresponds to AccessPolicySettings / AccessPolicySettingsPerID. policyId is an integer (1-65535) for Fabric Engine (VOSS) or a name string for Switch Engine (EXOS). Filter support is provided on all fields. Returns an empty array if no entries are found in the database or no matching filters. Parent record references: To retrieve the associated access_policy_global_config details, query API /retrieve-asset-access-policy-global-config with filter id=access_policy_global_config_id.

## POST `/retrieve-asset-lldp-neighbor-xmed-poe-pd`

Operation: `retrieveAssetLldpNeighborXmedPoePd`

Retrieve AssetLldpNeighborXmedPoePd. AssetLldpNeighborXmedPoePd - This object describes the lldp neighbor MED POE PD info list. Row classification: A row is created for every AssetLldpNeighborXmed record (1:1 fan-out) regardless of whether the neighbor advertised a MED Extended Power via MDI TLV (ANSI/TIA-1057 Section 10.2.5). This means rows fall into two categories: GENUINE PoE row: the…

Retrieve AssetLldpNeighborXmedPoePd. AssetLldpNeighborXmedPoePd - This object describes the lldp neighbor MED POE PD info list. Row classification: A row is created for every AssetLldpNeighborXmed record (1:1 fan-out) regardless of whether the neighbor advertised a MED Extended Power via MDI TLV (ANSI/TIA-1057 Section 10.2.5). This means rows fall into two categories: GENUINE PoE row: the neighbor sent an Extended Power TLV. Indicated by: device_type IS NOT NULL AND power_source > 0. These represent real powered or power-sourcing devices and should be included in PoE analytics (count, by priority, by source). PLACEHOLDER row: the neighbor is MED-capable but sent no PoE TLV. Indicated by: device_type IS NULL AND power_source = 0. These are hollow rows with no PoE meaning and should be EXCLUDED from PoE analytics. Knowledge graph filter rule: Include as powered device: device_type = 'PD_DEVICE' Include as power source: device_type = 'PSE_DEVICE' Include with low confidence: device_type = 'UNKNOWN' AND power_source > 0 (PoE TLV received but type unresolvable; may be PD or PSE) Exclude: device_type IS NULL OR power_source = 0 Filter support is provided on all fields. Returns an empty array if no entries are found in the database or no matching filters. Parent record references: To retrieve the associated asset_lldp_neighbor_xmed details, query API /retrieve-asset-lldp-neighbor-xmed with filter id=asset_lldp_neighbor_xmed_id.

Tags: `AssetLldpNeighborXmedPoePd`

Parameters:

- `page_number` query, optional (integer) — Page number to fetch the data
- `page_size` query, optional (integer) — Page size to fetch the data

Request body:

- `application/json` — AssetLldpNeighborXmedPoePdGetRequest

Responses:

- `200` — Successful operation
- `400` — Bad request
- `401` — Unauthorized. Authentication is required or has failed.
- `415` — Unsupported media type
- `500` — Internal server error
- `default` — Unexpected error

Retrieve AssetLldpNeighborXmedPoePse. AssetLldpNeighborXmedPoePse - This object describes the lldp neighbor MED POE PSE list. Row classification: A row is created for every AssetLldpNeighborXmed record (1:1 fan-out) regardless of whether the neighbor advertised a MED Extended Power via MDI TLV (ANSI/TIA-1057 Section 10.2.5). GENUINE PoE row: the neighbor sent an Extended Power TLV. Indicated by: device_type IS NOT NULL AND power_source > 0. PLACEHOLDER row: the neighbor is MED-capable but sent no PoE TLV. Indicated by: device_type IS NULL AND power_source = 0. These are hollow rows and should be EXCLUDED from PoE analytics. Knowledge graph filter rule: Include as power source: device_type = 'PSE_DEVICE' Include as powered device: device_type = 'PD_DEVICE' Include with low confidence: device_type = 'UNKNOWN' AND power_source > 0 Exclude: device_type IS NULL OR device_type = 'NONE' OR power_source = 0 Filter support is provided on all fields. Returns an empty array if no entries are found in the database or no matching filters. Parent record references: To retrieve the associated asset_lldp_neighbor_xmed details, query API /retrieve-asset-lldp-neighbor-xmed with filter id=asset_lldp_neighbor_xmed_id.
